Find the largest of three numbers.

Supplied answer
a = int(input("Enter a: "))
b = int(input("Enter b: "))
c = int(input("Enter c: "))
if a >= b and a >= c:
    print("a is the greatest:", a)
elif b >= a and b >= c:
    print("b is the greatest:", b)
else:
    print("c is the greatest:", c)
# one-line alternative
print("Greatest =", max(a, b, c))
Note: Use >= instead of > so equal numbers do not fall to the wrong branch.
